Partners for your flagged words

Every word you flagged in Clepsydra, each with the words it is most likely confused with. Tap a word to pair it with the flagged one; tap again to undo. If none fit, + another word searches the whole deck (Latin or English), and no partner marks a word that is hard on its own. A pair ticked under one word shows as ticked under the other.

Nothing reaches the app until you download the file and bring it in: in Clepsydra, tap the sync ring first, then Settings → Backups → Bring in tied pairs, pick the file, and sync again. It only adds ties. Bringing the same file in twice does no harm. Your ticks are saved in this browser as you go, and Load a file reads back a file you downloaded earlier, so you can carry progress from your phone to a laptop.
